bias.en: Pullback deepening · MACD and SAR turned bearish, at the 30-day
bias.zh: 回调加深 · MACD 和 SAR 转空，回到 30 日均线

read.en: Zscaler fell 5.9% on Nov 2 to $223.79, trading between $223.42 and $238.02 on light volume (0.68 times average). It is below the rising 5-day ($245.1) and 10-day ($242.5) averages and just above the rising 30-day ($221.4), 100-day ($177.9) and 200-day ($166.9). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 2, still above zero; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Nov 2 ($267.87), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月2日下跌 5.9%，收于 $223.79，盘中区间 $223.42–238.02，成交量偏低（均量的 0.68 倍）。股价位于上行的 5 日（$245.1）和 10 日均线（$242.5）下方，略高于上行的 30 日（$221.4）、100 日（$177.9）和 200 日均线（$166.9）。MACD 于 11月2日下穿信号线，仍在零轴之上；抛物线 SAR 于 11月2日转为看空（$267.87），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The drop broke the $231.6–234.2 support (Oct 22–30 lows), now resistance, and flipped both MACD and the SAR bearish. Resistance is $231.6–234.2, then $237.8–238 (Oct 30 close, Nov 2 high) and $241.2–245.1 (Oct 22 high, 10 and 5-day). Support is $220.1–221.4 (30-day, Oct 14 low), then $214.5 (Oct 21 low) and $203.3 (Oct 16 low). A close above $234.2 would target $238–241; below $220, $214.5.
